description: List mindfulness sessions recorded in the Oura app (meditation, breathing, relaxation, nap, rest, body status) with mood, start and end time, duration, and heart-rate and HRV stats (avg/min/max). Use it for questions about guided practice and how it affected heart rate or HRV; sleep is in list_sleep_periods and exercise in list_workouts. Range: the last 7 days by default; set start and end (inclusive, YYYY-MM-DD) or days (up to 400, ignored when start is set). Returns { records, next_token }, oldest first. Days without data are absent, and today's data appears only after the ring syncs. If next_token is not null, call again with it for the rest. raw: true returns Oura's original objects.

days.description: Shortcut for start: the last N days up to end. Ignored when start is set.

end.description: Last day to include (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today.

next_token.description: Pass the next_token from a previous call to get the following records.

raw.description: Return Oura's raw API objects instead of compact summaries with friendly units.

name: list_sessions
title: List sessions
